# breadmachine.io / bread-calc

A static-site hydration calculator for bread machines, calibrated for the
Zojirushi BB-PDC20. The calculation engine is open source and available as
the npm package `bread-calc`.

## Verify a calculation
npm install -g bread-calc
bread-calc compute recipe.bread.json --json | jq '.payload.hydration.effective_pct'

## Subcommands (v2.0)
compute     — evaluate a recipe, emit ComputedRecipe envelope
solve       — back-solve grams from baker's percentages + target weight
validate    — schema + reference check; non-zero exit on errors
explain     — narrative derivation for any metric
verify      — check claimed metric values against actual computation
parse       — convert markdown/CSV/loose text to a v2.0 Recipe
apply       — apply a Fix to a Recipe and return the new Recipe
convert     — change recipe units (g/oz, baker's-% / grams)
lookup      — query the ingredient database
describe    — emit machine-readable capability manifest
examples    — list bundled example recipes
plot        — render a hydration-zone SVG
